items.lede: Unlike narrated audiobooks from Audible and other providers, the audiobooks created with Virtual Voice in Kindle+ will instead be narrated by AI.
items.title: Amazon’s Kindle Unlimited is now Kindle+, and the 2 big changes include AI audiobooks

items.lede: The plus-ification of subscription services continues unabated with Amazon becoming the latest company to follow suit with a Kindle Unlimited rebrand. The subscription service is now known as Kindle Plus but will continue to offer unlimited access to a select collection of ebooks, comics, and magazines from the Kindle catalog for $11.99 per month. items.lede: The service still offers a library of books, magazines and comics, and now includes a larger selection of audiobooks.
